Exact relative file and full title identify each case; line movement and reruns do not create new cases. The latest completed result, ordered by log modification timestamp, supersedes older results. Skips are not passes. Six integrated performance cases are excluded and require separate acceptance evidence. Raw logs are retained in ignored local audit artifacts; this file contains only public test identities, outcomes, log filenames, and prerequisite reasons.
